paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Bisna (interpreted it) before Rav Yosef. Rav Yosef said to him, “You have distressed me”: Kiddushin 26b; Rashi and Arukh explain it, see there. He asked Abaye: Niddah 42a. He said in Rav Nahman's name: Ketubbot 100a.
